Asian Development Bank

A financial architecture for early warning.

Increasing Investments in Early Warning Systems to Strengthen Climate and Disaster Resilience

ROLE

Economic and Financial Analysis Specialist (International), Intermittent

PERIOD / PORTFOLIO

2025–2026

GEOGRAPHY

Regional — Bangladesh, Cambodia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyz Republic, Lao PDR, Maldives, Mongolia, Nepal, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan

THE ASSIGNMENT
ContextContributionRelated expertise

ADB TA 10103-REG (sovereign regional TA 57055-001)

The question
behind the work.

Economic and financial analysis for a regional early-warning initiative spanning ten countries. Facility design, investment frameworks, costing models and financing inputs.

Design and initiation of a multi-hazard EWS facility to help DMCs identify, prepare, and implement scalable EWS investments. The TA will contribute to strengthening of early warning systems (EWS) and increasing investments of ADB on EWS in support of its developing member countries. The TA's expected outcome is a new facility on early warning system initiated.

The scope below describes the specialist’s responsibilities and inputs. It does not claim that the proposed facility or every planned output has been completed.

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Run rapid diagnostics of hydromet/hazard/alerting gaps; conduct stakeholder mapping and country consultations.

  2. 02

    Draft the facility blueprint (governance, financing instruments, eligibility, safeguards interface).

  3. 03

    Prepare investment concept notes and screening templates; prioritize pilot concepts for Bangladesh and Cambodia.

  4. 04

    Build costing toolkits and CBA models; support budget notes and procurement plans.

  5. 05

    Author SOPs and technical specifications for multi-channel alerting (cell broadcast, SMS, IVR, FM, community).

  6. 06

    Design an M&E logframe aligned to Sendai and SDG 13; plan integration with national systems.

  7. 07

    Develop financial evaluation packages, benchmark WACC, and assess O&M sustainability over asset life.

  8. 08

    Draft Economic & Financial Analysis chapters for three country CIEWS investment frameworks.

  9. 09

    Contribute donor-ready proposal materials (economic justification, financial projections, risks/mitigation, implementation and financing plans).
